_comment: Questions asked of the real chat pipeline by scripts/demo/generate_demo_conversations.py. Each `items` entry is an item id in the shipped bundle's manifest (bundle-v1). A question is asked in its own conversation, followed by its follow-ups. At least half of the conversations are cross-file. The privacy-redaction item id is reserved for the scripted clip that the owner still has to record (bundle-v1/privacy-demo/SCRIPT.md); until it exists in the manifest, the generator reports it as missing. Questions that name specifics (dates, topics) are drawn from the items' opening captions (YouTube auto-captions) or page descriptions and must be rechecked against the transcripts once they exist.

conversations.title: What do the two Spanish-language reports cover?
questions: Summarize each Spanish-language report in two sentences.
What does the first report say about how artificial intelligence is advancing in Latin America, and what does the second describe about the National Museum of Colombia?
Which report mentions Fernando Botero or Gabriel Garcia Marquez, and in what context?

conversations.title: What do the Russian-language features explain about life in the US?
questions: Give a one-line summary of each Russian-language feature.
What facts does the winemaking feature give, and what facts does the firefighters feature give?
What does the eco-house report say about cost, and how does it compare to the other two reports in style?

conversations.title: What do the two Chinese-language Gen Z reports say?
questions: What is each report about?
What view of American national parks and of podcast culture does the presenter give?
How do the two reports differ in tone and structure?

conversations.title: Which languages are in the news collection and what are the topics?
questions: List each report with its language and a one-sentence topic.
